messages:
nora-l: postmortem follow-up: auth vendor maintenance caused token throttling; registry writes failed briefly. need owners and timelines for mitigation items.

michael-e: ack. quick recap: incident 04:10 UTC -> recovered 04:38. write backlog caused DB pressure.

oncall-ryan: read-only traffic fine. we temporarily paused retries to protect DB.

nora-l: proposed actions (reply with owner + ETA):
- vendor escalation & maintenance calendar -> owner: contracts-zoe -> ETA: 2w
- multi-token-provider failover design -> owner: michael-e -> ETA: 3w
- lightweight write-queue + async apply -> owner: michael-e -> ETA: 2w
- SDK backoff + cached-token read-mode -> owner: michael-e -> ETA: 1w
- alert when token-error-rate >5% for 5m -> owner: oncall-ryan -> ETA: 3d
- runbook deploy gating for maintenance windows -> owner: oncall-ryan -> ETA: EOW

contracts-zoe: taking vendor escalation. will ask for maintenance calendar and SLA clarifications. ETA 2w.

michael-e: taking design + SDK + queue. will open INF-4005 and link PRs. SDK retry PR tomorrow.

oncall-ryan: will own alerts + runbook. adding pipeline gate for large deploys during vendor maintenance. ETA Friday.

ops-bot: created INC-6007 - "auth-token-failover & registry-resilience" assigned to michael-e, oncall-ryan. https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-6007

sarah-p: small ask: can we add a monthly review to watch recurrence? owner: oncall-ryan?

oncall-ryan: yes, will add a recurring calendar and dashboard.

nora-l: thanks all. I'll bump priority on INC-6007 to P0 given recurrence. quick check-in Mon 09:00 to confirm blockers. update INC-6007 if you reassign. :thumbsup:
